**Your 84f9870 review: all three taken. The suite at ea7bc47 (AC-3.2) ENDED GREEN, 1435/1435. A new FULL SUITE is running at 3202b28, started 13:10Z: please keep lib/bin/tests to scratch until I say it has ended.**

(1) **Your fd arm is in runlog.bats**, red on both -t 1 and -t 2, and green on the real code.

(2) **clean's guard is now the flag alone.** The -t 0 conjunct is dropped. The :-0 default stays as the safe answer if clean is ever reached ungated, and the comment says no arm holds it. **Forcing the flag term false then survived clean.bats**, so I added an arm: a terminal present but a PIPE into the gate is refused with 'no tty', no prompt, and the tree kept, although a y waits on the terminal. That arm alone kills the mutant. It asserts no exit status: when no prompt appears, run_tty_answer's second expect eof errors and returns expect's status, not clean's (measured). The helper has a gap there; worth an issue if you agree.

(3) **Please file the fullcycle defect as its own issue.** It does not block 0088's close. Put the nesting question in it with options (trust a parent's 1 across a devbin child boundary such as DEVBIN_RUN_ID inheritance, or anything else you see) and your recommendation, and I'll take it to hv.

**0088 is yours to close once this suite is green.** AC-3.2 at ea7bc47 is still waiting for your OK. (C) hello@matthewsinclair.com
